resources.string: Swipe left, up or right anywhere on the trackpad for the left, middle or right suggestion. Swipe left no longer deletes a word.
Swipe down deletes the previous word
A quick swipe down on the trackpad deletes the word before the cursor.
Open the phone\'s Keyboard gestures settings, for scrolling and moving the cursor on the keys. Also in the quick launcher as \"Trackpad scroll & cursor\".
Search Settings for \"%1$s\": it\'s copied, ready to paste.
